summary: Trip.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the timing of its Q2 and first-half 2026 results. The audit committee will meet on September 14, 2026 (HK time) to approve results, which will be published on September 16, 2026 (HK time) / September 15 US time, followed by a conference call. No special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or restructuring are present; this is a routine earnings date notice under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are mentioned. The only watch item is the earnings release itself for any forward-looking commentary.
